objective: Improve Community photo and video feed rendering with identity-safe photo framing and decoded-video aspect ratios, without replacing media engines or touching backend/native config.
productionBaselineEvidence: Source baseline main @ 11cf6bd096054dbf8ac204186b199fc835e740e3. Existing Android preview/original compositing and compact photo viewer are retained; physical device pixels remain unverified.
chosenApproach: Derive single-photo height/fit from decoded dimensions; prevent recycled photo state leakage; derive inline Expo Video frame height from the selected VideoTrack size and keep fullscreen layout unchanged.
selectionRationale: Avoid arbitrary cropping and stale recycled dimensions with bounded, source-grounded layout rather than a risky renderer rewrite.
preserveBehaviors: Private signed originals and stable cache keys
Android preview visible until verified original paints
Existing collage geometry and photo viewer actions
Video cache, bounded retry, signed URL refresh and single-player lifecycle
Fullscreen video sizing and saved playback position
IMA ads, companion placements and ad events
No backend, RLS, storage, native dependency or package identity changes
acceptanceChecks: Extreme tall/panoramic photos do not crop meaningful pixels
Recycled photo tiles cannot reuse stale dimensions
Inline video frame follows selected decoded track dimensions within bounded height
Video is never stretched and contain is used when the bounded frame cannot match source ratio
Fullscreen, IMA and weak-network behavior remain compatible
Focused media tests, TypeScript and engineering gates pass
Physical-device visual verification remains an RC gate
alternativeApproaches: Keep one fixed 300–520 dp video box and accept cropping (rejected: source orientation is unknown at layout time).
Force contain for every photo (rejected: it letterboxes ordinary portrait/landscape photos unnecessarily).
Replace the media engine or introduce a native module (rejected: unnecessary runtime and regression risk).
